text: Lets use hammerspoon. I want to call up a text entry box and be able to type a thought and press enter and it gets added to daily note. I don't want obsidian to get pulled up and interfere with what I am doing though.

title: Add Hammerspoon hotkey quick-capture to daily note via Actions URI
body: Edit chezmoi source dot_hammerspoon/init.lua only; append silent daily-note capture, then chezmoi apply that file

cmd: shale intent "Add Hammerspoon hotkey quick-capture to daily note via Actions URI" --body "Edit chezmoi source dot_hammerspoon/init.lua only; append silent daily-note capture, then chezmoi apply that file"; chezmoi diff ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua | head -5; echo "diff-rc=$?"

note: Added Hammerspoon cmd+ctrl+alt+N quick capture to chezmoi source init.lua and applied that file; not run end-to-end

cmd: (luac -p ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_hammerspoon/init.lua 2>&1 || lua -e 'loadfile(os.getenv("HOME").."/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_hammerspoon/init.lua")' 2>&1 || echo "no lua available"); chezmoi apply ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua && echo applied; shale done --note "Added Hammerspoon cmd+ctrl+alt+N quick capture to chezmoi source init.lua and applied that file; not run end-to-end" 2>&1 | tail -1

title: Move quick capture from direct hotkey to Hammerflow leader F18 then n
body: Edit chezmoi source dot_hammerspoon init.lua and home.toml; apply those two files

cmd: shale intent "Move quick capture from direct hotkey to Hammerflow leader F18 then n" --body "Edit chezmoi source dot_hammerspoon init.lua and home.toml; apply those two files"
grep -n -E 'quickCapture|registerFunctions|loadFirstValid' ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_hammerspoon/init.lua

cd ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_hammerspoon; grep -n -E 'quickCapture|registerFunctions|loadFirstValid|^local function' init.lua; chezmoi diff ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua ~/.hammerspoon/home.toml | grep -E '^[+-]' | head -50
chezmoi apply ~/.hammerspoon/init.lua ~/.hammerspoon/home.toml && echo applied

note: Quick capture now F18 then n via Hammerflow (home.toml top-level n, function registered after definition); direct hotkey removed; not run end-to-end

cmd: shale done --note "Quick capture now F18 then n via Hammerflow (home.toml top-level n, function registered after definition); direct hotkey removed; not run end-to-end" | tail -1
